goal.description: High-level user goal for Alpha. Keep bulky documents, parsed PDF text, logs, generated files, and archives out of this string; pass them through TaskEnvelope.input_artifacts or delegate_to_agent.artifact_ids so Alpha can inspect staged files directly. If context comes from a parsed bundle, pass the source artifact reference rather than only a bundle_id.

mode.description: Whether Alpha should create a new project, use an existing project, or infer automatically.

project_ref.description: Existing Alpha project id, alias, repo URL, deployment URL, local path, prior task id, artifact id, or natural-language project/task reference.

aliases.description: Optional aliases for a newly created Alpha project.

repo_url.description: Repository URL associated with a new Alpha project.

deployment_url.description: Deployment URL associated with a new Alpha project.

preferred_harness.description: Preferred execution harness. OpenCode (Zen models) is the COSMIC default; Codex, Cursor, and auto are also executable. If no harness is supplied here, the VM-level Settings > Agents selection applies.

opencode_session_id.description: OpenCode-specific native session id to resume.

preferred_model.description: Optional CLI model override for this task.

model.description: Optional CLI model override for this task.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional Codex CLI reasoning effort override for this task. Maps to codex exec -c model_reasoning_effort=...; omit or use auto to respect the Settings > Agents > Codex default.

codex_sandbox.description: Codex sandbox mode for model-generated shell commands.

allow_cross_harness_fallback.description: When true, Alpha may continue the same workspace with the other authenticated CLI harness after same-provider retries are exhausted. Default is false so a selected provider such as Cursor is retried and diagnosed before any provider switch.

allow_harness_fallback.description: Legacy alias for allow_cross_harness_fallback. Default is false; do not set true unless cross-provider continuation is explicitly acceptable.

native_resume_policy.description: Native CLI session policy for Alpha. auto reuses the best healthy provider-native session for the resolved Alpha project when safe; fresh creates a new native session; disabled runs without native session resume; force prefers a supplied native_session_id/cursor_chat_id.

native_session_id.description: Optional provider-native session/chat id to resume for this task. For Cursor this is a chat id.

cursor_chat_id.description: Cursor-specific native chat id to resume.

fresh_native_session.description: When true, do not reuse an existing provider-native session; create a fresh one when supported.

disable_native_resume.description: When true, run the selected harness without provider-native session resume.

max_harness_attempts.description: Maximum attempts with the selected CLI harness before failing or, only when allow_cross_harness_fallback=true, trying another authenticated harness.

require_preferred_harness.description: When true, Alpha must not fall back to another CLI harness. Use only for provider diagnostics or user-mandated provider runs.

approval_policy.description: Future approval posture for Alpha execution.

constraints.description: Optional structured constraints for the project task.

run_workspace_smoke.description: Run a harmless Docker workspace smoke test only when ALPHA_ALLOW_DOCKER_SMOKE=true.

prepare_only.description: Prepare or recall the Alpha workspace without running the selected CLI.
